verdict.rationale: Otter has documented integrations with Slack-adjacent workflow tools (Zendesk, ServiceNow, JIRA, Asana, ClickUp, Airtable, Glean), Zapier and CRM/API connections (otter-docs-9,10,25,26,28,31,40), plus MCP for AI-tool workflows — but notably Slack and Notion are never explicitly named anywhere in the evidence, and community reports focus on privacy/accuracy issues rather than integration reliability. missing for 10: explicit Slack integration evidence, explicit Notion integration evidence, independent hands-on verification of Zapier/CRM sync working reliably.
